note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (the third Šķēle government of the People's Party, Latvian Way and For Fatherland and Freedom/LNNK, pursuing EU and NATO accession), not measured data.

interest_groups.note: Small conscript National Armed Forces; NATO accession was a government priority.
Business figures were prominent in party politics (the People's Party was founded by former prime minister and businessman Andris Šķēle).
Lutheran, Catholic and Orthodox churches; limited political weight.
The Farmers' Union narrowly missed the threshold in 1998.
Large Russian-speaking minority, many of them non-citizens in 2000; represented in the Saeima by the National Harmony Party list.
